competences.description: Attacks without waking up the enemy that's under Sleep. Puts the target to Sleep for 1 turn with a 50% chance. Recovers the Attack Bar by 50% if the enemy falls asleep after the attack.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks without waking up the enemy that's under Sleep. Replaces up to 3 beneficial effects granted on the target with Sleep, Increased chances of landing a Glancing Hit, and Decrease DEF Effects for 2 turns each.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks without waking up the enemy that's under Sleep. Attacks all enemies to disturb their HP recovery for 2 turns with a 75% chance. If the enemy is under Sleep, this attack will deal damage that ignores 50% of the enemy's Defense.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.
